C0215.title: Shanghai's First Government Voucher Subsidy Fraud Verdict: Dicos Store Manager Cashes Out ¥137,000
C0215.summary: From November 9 to November 28, 2024, Xia, legal representative of a Shanghai catering management company, purchased 'Lepin Shanghai' dining vouchers (1000-off-300) on the Xianyu marketplace and cashed them out by fabricating 1000-yuan in-store consumption flows, fraudulently claiming a 300-yuan government subsidy per voucher. Over 19 days she redeemed more than 400 vouchers, defrauding subsidies totaling over 130,000 yuan. On May 29, 2025, Shanghai Songjiang Court convicted Xia of fraud, sentencing her to three years' imprisonment with a three-year reprieve and a fine.
